info.title: Yoast SEO Universal API
info.description: Retrieve Yoast SEO metadata, Yoast-enriched WordPress REST responses for content types and taxonomies, and Schema Aggregator outputs for WordPress sites running Yoast SEO.

get.summary: Get Aggregated Schema For Post Type
get.description: Retrieves aggregated schema for a post type.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: postType
parameters.description: Post type slug to aggregate, such as post, page, or product.

schema.description: Post type slug to aggregate, such as post, page, or product.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Schema aggregation page number.

schema.description: Schema aggregation page number.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

rawBody.description: Raw newline-delimited JSON-LD returned by the schema aggregator endpoint.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.
